method.byte_ratio: median of actual_frame_bytes / logical_bytes over every candidate that was encoded in the FIT split
method.decode: least-squares slope through the origin of measured cold read ns against logical MiB, per chosen strategy
method.encode: least-squares slope through the origin of measured encode phase ns against logical MiB, per chosen strategy
method.publish: least-squares slope through the origin of measured blob-publish ns against stored MiB, pooled
method.restore_overhead: median residual (read ns - slope*MiB), clamped at zero
method.write_overhead: median residual (per-object write wall - encode - publish), clamped at zero

subset.rule: every tensor with byte_len <= the declared bound, strided by the smallest k that keeps the subset within the declared tensor and byte bounds
